Read segmantR output

Source: R/import.R
cr_read_segmantr.Rd

Imports an RDS file produced by the segmantR segmentation package. Accepts either a segmantr_result list (where cells are in $cells) or a plain data frame.

Usage

cr_read_segmantr(path)

Arguments

path

Path to RDS file.

Value

A tibble of cells.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
df <- cr_example_experiment(seed = 1, n_cells_per_well = 5)$cells
saveRDS(df, tmp)
cells <- cr_read_segmantr(tmp)
head(cells)
